properties.description: **Enterprise** — Zero-trust and regulatory alignment for HDInsight: controls that require infrastructure investment or map directly to compliance frameworks. This tier delivers customer-managed keys (CMK / BYOK) for cryptographic sovereignty and direct mapping to regulatory framework controls. Together these policies protect against lateral movement, sovereign-data exfiltration, and audit gaps in regulated workloads. metadata.policyName: Azure HDInsight clusters should use customer-managed keys to encrypt data at rest
